content.text: You’ve spent months producing your beats, mastering your tracks, and building a following. Now you’re ready to sell your music online. But here’s the problem: Stripe and PayPal don’t operate in Kenya. Conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-stack-started-generating-5|COREMERCH guide to payment]] gateways lock you out. Your audience can’t buy your music because the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-kyc-payment-gateways-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-honest-side-2|Digital Product]]-sellers-2|infrastructure]] you need doesn’t exist. This isn’t a workaround problem. It’s a base-layer infrastructure problem. COREMERCH solves this by deploying sovereign commerce stacks that let you sell music, accept Bitcoin, and deliver files automatically—no Stripe required. This isn’t a platform. It’s infrastructure you own. No subscriptions. No rent. No gatekeepers. Your store runs on GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. You own the code. You control the data. Your customers pay in crypto. The system verifies payments on-chain and delivers files instantly. This is how you sell music online when the financial system excludes you.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

This is sovereign commerce infrastructure—a complete digital commerce stack designed to let you sell music without relying on third-party platforms. It’s not a plugin or a SaaS tool. It’s a combination of free and paid tools deployed as your own system. GitHub Pages hosts your store. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. NOWPayments processes crypto payments. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers your music files automatically. The architecture is modular, meaning you own every component. No single point of failure. No platform fees. No revenue sharing. When a customer buys your music, payment is verified on-chain via NOWPayments. The system triggers file delivery instantly. You never touch the transaction. You never manage inventory. The stack operates autonomously. This is how you sell music in a region where conventional payment processors don’t work. It’s infrastructure built for creators who need to own their systems.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack is simple but powerful. Your store lives on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, depending on your stack. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery is handled via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments integrates as the payment processor, accepting 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. When a customer buys your music, NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain. A webhook triggers the delivery script. The file is sent to the customer’s email or download page instantly. No manual intervention. No waiting. The system is stateless—it doesn’t store customer data. You own the code. You control the flow. The architecture is designed to be lightweight, fast, and resistant to regional payment restrictions. It’s not a workaround. It’s a permanent solution.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other payment processors are unavailable or severely restricted. If you’re in Kenya, Nigeria, Zimbabwe, or similar markets, this is your solution. You sell music, beats, presets, or courses. You need to accept payments globally. You need to deliver files automatically. You need to own your infrastructure. This stack is for you. It’s not built for creators who can use conventional platforms. It’s built for those who need to bypass them. It’s pressure-tested in Zimbabwe—a market with currency collapse and financial isolation. If it works there, it works anywhere. This isn’t a tool for victims. It’s a tool for creators who chose better architecture. You’re not renting a platform. You’re deploying your own system. You’re not dependent on anyone. You’re in control.
Own your infrastructure. No platform fees. No gatekeepers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is composed of five core components. First, hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free and globally distributed. Second, backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Workers are faster and more scalable. Apps Script is simpler to set up. Third, order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. Supabase is a full database. Sheets is easier for small catalogs. Fourth, file delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both are reliable and cost-effective. Fifth, payment processing: NOWPayments. It accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. These components integrate seamlessly. The system is modular—you can swap components as needed. For example, start with Google Sheets and upgrade to Supabase later. The stack is designed to grow with you. It’s not a locked-in platform. It’s open infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours with GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. If you want to build it yourself, buy the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all blueprints and templates. Deploy your store. Load your music products. Test end-to-end. Go live. The system handles payments, delivery, and order storage automatically. You focus on creating. Your customers pay in crypto. The system verifies payments and delivers files. No manual work. No platform fees. You own everything. This is how you sell music online when Stripe and PayPal aren’t options. It’s not a workaround. It’s infrastructure. Deploy it today.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling music online and accepting Bitcoin without Stripe or PayPal requires sovereign commerce infrastructure. Deploy a stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. Files are delivered automatically via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The system verifies payments on-chain and triggers delivery instantly. You own the code and data. No platform fees. No gatekeepers. This is how creators in restricted markets sell music globally.
Accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments. 0.5% fee only.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Ready to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack? The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints, templates, and guides to build and deploy your music store. It’s everything you need to sell music online, accept Bitcoin, and deliver files automatically—no Stripe required. Own your infrastructure. Control your commerce. Start today.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. 2. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit if building yourself. 3. Set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 4. Configure backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. 6. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. 7. Set up file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 8. Load your music products into the system. 9. Test end-to-end: payment, delivery, and order storage. 10. Go live and start selling.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I accept payments in local currency?
NOWPayments converts crypto payments to USD at transaction time. You can price your music in USD, and customers pay in their preferred cryptocurrency. The system handles the conversion automatically.
How are files delivered to customers?
Files are delivered automatically via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Once payment is verified, a webhook triggers the delivery script, sending the file to the customer’s email or download page.
Do I need to manage inventory?
No. The system is stateless and handles file delivery automatically. You upload your music files once, and the system delivers them as needed. No manual intervention required.
What cryptocurrencies can customers use?
NOWPayments accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON—all under $0.10 per transaction.
Can I upgrade my stack later?
Yes. The architecture is modular. You can start with simpler components like Google Sheets and upgrade to Supabase or Cloudflare Workers as your store grows.
